mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, m.content, m.is_top, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, m.content, m.is_top, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, m.content, m.is_top AS isTop, m.create_time AS createTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id
AND (m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC
